fixed.name: Graviton Suit
fixed.text: Land and underwater speed 30 ft/AP, climb 20 ft/AP (only while the suit's graviton tech works). While falling you can move horizontally as if walking (you do not fall slower or more safely).

fixed.name: Massive Pressure Suit
fixed.text: Your suit is a massive-2 creature (Narrator's Accomplice pp.102–103): it takes up 4 mutually adjacent spaces and has a physical reach of 10 ft. Weapons made to abyssal scale have a damage class 4 higher than normal for their category. Unarmed damage class 6. You wield human-scale weapons as if they were two size categories smaller (a heavy melee weapon counts as light for specialties etc.). For moving, lifting or otherwise physically manipulating objects, and for resisting the same, you act as if you had a starting Brute of 10. This does not apply to resisting poisons and similar effects.

modifiers.label: starting Brute counts as (move/lift/resist being moved, not poisons)

fixed.name: Feeding Tendrils
fixed.text: Two feeding tendrils that end in toothed mouths. Use them for unarmed attacks and grabs like hands, but not to use items. For called shots and wounds they count as an extra pair of hands. A tendril that suffers a wound retreats into the suit and cannot be targeted. You may retract the tendrils at any time for 1 AP.

fixed.name: Telepathy
fixed.text: Inside the suit you communicate only telepathically, with no language barrier. You can speak into the mind of any conscious, openly perceptive person. A target can close the channel with an opposed Spirit roll (the one closing must roll highest).

fixed.name: Vital Armor
fixed.text: The pressure suit is your body for hit points, called shots, wounds etc. At 0 HP you fall unconscious, and the suit's interface organism flees with you until you recover HP. Any fatal wound breaches the suit: catastrophic explosive decompression and death. The suit is organic, so it is still affected by poisons, bio-zappers, certain acids and other attacks on biology. Natural soak 3. You cannot wear armor, but you can augment the suit (see Augmenting the Mantle).

fixed.name: Circumspection
fixed.text: Light detection and echolocation let you perceive everything in 360°, but not through cover heavier than Poor.

fixed.name: Arctic Affinity
fixed.text: No penalties from subzero temperatures. Immune to cold damage, cold environmental conditions and augments like Cryothermal.

random.name: Astral Control
random.text: You were never in the suit: you control it remotely from an ancient spire in the abyssopelagic zone. When the suit is destroyed the character still counts as dead, until the narrator lets you haul a new biosuit up from the depths and meet the party again (long delay, big roleplay fallout, possible mental trauma). Not to be abused for immortality.

random.name: Collapsed Mantle
random.text: The suit's soak class starts at 4 instead of 3.

random.name: Defensive Photocells
random.text: Bioluminescent clusters light up everything within 10 ft (can be suppressed at will). Overcharge for 1 AP: blinding light at a target within 25 ft. The target resists your Sciences with Cunning or is blinded for one turn.

random.name: Enhanced Graviton

random.name: Galvanic Sense

modifiers.label: Spirit to close your telepathic channel

random.name: More Mouths

random.name: Truly Omnivorous

fixed.name: Spring-Loaded Legs

random.name: Animal Husbandry

random.name: Bellowing Bravado
random.text: Your croaks carry over a wide radius, and you choose their tone (challenge, warning, distress, call for help, 'who's around?'). Specialties that need you to be very loud (e.g. Deafening Roar, Lion's Roar) get +5 when rolling for their effect.

modifiers.label: Deafening Roar, Lion's Roar effect roll

random.name: Dart Tongue

Unattended item: succeeds automatically unless you roll a natural 1. On success the item is held in your mouth; taking it out by hand costs 0 AP. The narrator may require a Brute roll for heavier objects.

random.name: Guiding Herbalist

random.name: Leap Frog

You can prepare the antidote easily, even without Medicine Brewer or Alchemy points.

random.name: Half Crazak

random.name: Hive Mind

random.text: +6 to Cunning for social tells with chimeras, abominations, bio-corrupted people and creatures, and other results of extensive unwholesome biological alteration.

fixed.name: Khemic
fixed.text: Made to mimic humans, you easily pass for one. +3 to Cunning whenever interacting with people. You regain two wounds per day instead of one, recover from wound effects twice as fast, and can regrow a single called-shot location during a downtime.

random.name: Alchemical Oddity
random.text: +4 to resisting acids, poisons and gases.

random.name: Fearsome Form

random.name: Grounded
random.text: You can soak electrical damage like normal damage, with +1 soak to do so.

random.name: Hydrophobic

random.name: Lightning Rod

random.text: You can soak electrical damage like normal damage, with +1 soak to do so.

random.name: Hydrophobic
random.text: You can move across water at your normal land speed if not weighed down too much. Submerged, you cannot swim faster than 5 ft/AP.

random.name: Lightning Rod
random.text: You vent electricity into people or objects you are in contact with: they take the same electrical damage you take.

random.name: Pure Strain
random.text: Your essence came from one major race of your choice (ayodin, elf, farishtaa, gnome, human, satyr). Your movement speeds become that race's, and you may roll one trait from that race's random traits. You have all typical physical features of that race and those the rolled trait requires. Non-khemics are still clearly slimelike (disguise with clothes and makeup); khemics perfectly mimic the race externally.

random.name: Rigid Design
random.text: Your form never shifts or oozes. Amorphides lose their Evade bonus and Defense penalty and get +4 Defense instead; other fluoforms get just the +4 Defense.

random.name: Slick
random.text: +2 to evading grabs and +5 to breaking out of them.

random.name: Squeezer
random.text: While unarmored or in unrestricting minimal armor you can squeeze into or through any gap wider than a couple of inches. Squeezing movement gets −15 speed per AP (minimum 5).

random.name: Unsightly Undulations
random.text: +4 to intimidation and provocation rolls.

random.name: Viscous Veins
random.text: Tier up all resists against bleeding. You stop an additional 3 points of bleeding when you spend an AP to patch yourself up. Stopping you from bleeding out from a fatal effect costs 1 AP less.

fixed.name: Accustomed to Fire
fixed.text: Half damage while on fire or from heat damage. Can swim in lava (cannot breathe submerged). Immune to burns from fire/heat. Heat damage sets you on Tier 1 fire. While on fire, anything you touch may catch fire; living creatures roll a Dexterity resist to tier down the fire you spread to them.

fixed.name: Buried Breath
fixed.text: Tier up resists against gases and rolls to hold your breath.

fixed.name: Shocking Cold
fixed.text: Ice/cold conditions and cold augments always count as one tier or marque higher against you.

random.name: Beacon
random.text: Illuminate 10 ft around you and give off a little heat, at will (suppressible). Cannot overcome artificial darkness. While on fire: +10 ft radius per tier of the fire.

random.name: Born Engineer
random.text: Begin with 2 skill points in Engineering. Starting points may still be added there.

random.name: Branding Touch
random.text: Anyone touching you, or metal you touched for at least a turn, takes heat damage: 1 (levels 1–3), 2 (level 4+), 3 (level 8+). Stacks with Hot Iron (prosthetics) and Body of Flames (essence).

random.name: Cavern Carver
random.text: Dig barehanded: 15 ft dig speed through sand/soft soil. Roll Brute to dig through tougher material (tier + narrator).

random.name: Coal Dust
random.text: 1 AP: shed extra flammable soot onto a target (creature: Dexterity vs your Accuracy to avoid). A coated target tiers down resists vs burns/being set on fire and catches Tier 1 fire from heat damage. The dust is used up once it is burned or ignited.

random.name: Efficiency Above All
random.text: You and all nearby companions get +1 DIY. Does not stack between several gleedrin with this trait.

random.name: Extinguishing Experience
random.text: Putting out a fire on yourself costs 2 AP less (Tier 1 fires: 0 AP).

random.name: Inert Coal
random.text: You never catch fire, but still take damage from burning things or being engulfed (e.g. lava).

random.name: Living Wick
random.text: After successfully extinguishing a fire, absorb it for 1 AP (reflexive). Before your next breather, spend 2 AP to release it onto an adjacent space. An occupant may dodge it like an attack, otherwise suffers that fire tier.

random.name: Tunnel Sense
random.text: Tier up all rolls to navigate inside or underground (works without sight).

random.name: Work to Do
random.text: Each turn, 1 AP: ignore the effects of one called shot or wound, plus one more effect per additional AP. Cannot ignore chest or groin wounds.

random.name: Worthy Challenge
random.text: Heroics (Spirit): roll twice, take the higher.

fixed.name: Sharkskin Grip
fixed.text: +3 to maintain your grabs. Anyone grabbing you also gets +3 to maintain their grab.

fixed.name: Predatory
fixed.text: +2 Strike.

fixed.name: Blood in the Water
fixed.text: Track any organic creature/material by smell: +2 Cunning (+4 when tracking fresh blood).

fixed.name: Glint in the Void
fixed.text: +2 on all intimidation and provocation rolls, −2 on all pacification rolls.

random.name: Biting Scales
random.text: When grabbed: 1 AP reflexive to counter-grab and deal 3 unsoakable damage unless the grabber reflexively releases you (0 AP). +2 more to maintain that grab. Once per grab incident.

random.name: Black Spot
random.text: 2 AP: ink spray at a creature within 10 ft. It resists a called shot to the eyes (blurry vision) or legs (slips prone) against your Accuracy. Underwater: 15 ft long × 15 ft wide cone that acts as a gas with the Fogging augment.

random.name: Dead Rock
random.text: Coral plates: Soak +2. Wearing metal armor or armor heavier than medium: −4 Evade.

random.name: Deep Scale Slimer
random.text: Lose Sharkskin Grip. +3 to evade or break grabs (slime).

random.name: Eel Sense
random.text: Sense location and relative electrical power of living creatures and powered machines within 50 ft in water (15 ft out of water). Pinpointing = normal Cunning notice roll.

random.name: Feeding Frenzy
random.text: +2 Strike per enemy you kill in melee, reset after combat. Compulsive urge to eat your kills (disturbs everyone, karshin included).

modifiers.label: Strike per melee kill this combat (use Misc)

random.name: Fhtagn
random.text: Wing-fins are 6 tentacles (2 sets of 3). Swim 15, climb 25. Each tentacle holds a small item; 3 tentacles hold larger items or grab a called-shot location; all 6 wield two-handed items. No ranged weapons except thrown. Called shots target 3 tentacles at a time, count as arm+hand effects, resist with Brute or Dexterity (your choice).

random.name: Great White Flight
random.text: Automatically tier up all jumping rolls.

random.name: Imposing Majesty
random.text: Adjacent enemies get −2 on their Defense rolls.

random.name: Killing Claw
random.text: One hand is a crab claw: unarmed DC 4 with it, +3 to resist called shots there and +1 soak vs called-shot damage there. It can hold/grab items and targets but cannot wield/use items without your other hand.

random.name: Partially Boneless
random.text: +1 to all Evade rolls.

random.name: Shark and Awe
random.text: Melee attack on an unaware enemy outside combat: target is disoriented for turns equal to the damage tier.

fixed.name: Stigma of Fear
fixed.text: −4 on Cunning rolls to pacify or positively influence people. +2 on intimidation if you publicly reveal what you are.

fixed.name: Progressive Madness
fixed.text: Penalty to resists against provocation equal to your level. While provoked: +2 Strike against the provoker(s), −1 to all Evade rolls. Stacks per successful provocation (intentional or not).

fixed.name: Bestial Form
fixed.text: +2 Brute. Unarmed DC 4 with any body part. Can eat raw meat without ill effects.

random.name: Animal Reflex
random.text: When attacked in melee outside combat, roll Priority against the attacker's Priority. On success the surprise is negated and your HP are up before the hit (you still cannot evade it).

random.name: Carried on the Wind
random.text: Smell and hearing reach as far as your sight. They locate sources without line of sight.

random.name: Dedicated to the Cure
random.text: Begin with 2 skill points in Alchemy (starting points may still be added). Know the Rage Suppressant medicine augment and can make it as standalone potions without the Medicine Brewer specialty.

random.name: Eyes of the Hunter
random.text: Ignore poor-lighting penalties. Total darkness counts as poor lighting. Artificial darkness works normally.

random.name: Feral Roar
random.text: 2 AP: you and allies within 25 ft get +Strike equal to your max AP (by level) until the end of your next turn. Enemies within 25 ft get the same amount as a Strike penalty. Does not stack with itself.

random.name: Furious Backlash
random.text: After losing all HP: frenzy, +5 Strike and +5 to all movement speeds until you recover at least half your max HP.

random.name: Hardened Stomach
random.text: Tier up Brute resists against ingested poisons (incl. rotten food).

random.name: Hooked Tail
random.text: You can grab with your tail: +4 to sustain tail grabs. Cannot wield items with it.

random.name: Pack Mentality
random.text: Adjacent to a manticore ally: both get +2 Strike or +2 Defense (your choice). No stacking if the other also has this trait.

random.name: Restrained Rage
random.text: Progressive Madness penalty is halved (rounded down). Once per turn, free reroll of a resist against a successful provocation.

random.name: Savage Strength
random.text: +3 Brute, −2 Dexterity.

random.name: Takedown
random.text: +1 melee and unarmed DC against a target that has taken wound damage or suffers a fatal effect.

modifiers.label: target wounded or under a fatal effect

fixed.name: Multi-Dextrous
fixed.text: Feet and tail can be used as extra hands to hold items, but at least two hands must be free to move. +4 on Dexterity rolls.

fixed.name: Frail Body
fixed.text: −4 on all Brute rolls.

fixed.name: Life with a Volcano
fixed.text: No penalties from high temperatures. Fire you are caught on is reduced by 2 tiers.

random.name: Clever Monkey
random.text: +3 on all Cunning rolls.

random.name: Firebreather
random.text: Flame Breath attack: 2 AP, 10 ft range, DC 4, damage by Strike. Does not count toward your essence slots.

modifiers.label: Flame Breath DC (2 AP, 10 ft, Strike)

random.name: Geothermal Concentration
random.text: Make your magma spots glow: light in a 10 ft radius while not fatigued.

random.name: Gorilla Build
random.text: Swap Frail Body and Multi-Dextrous bonuses: +4 Brute, −4 Dexterity (extra hands remain).

random.name: Hard Back
random.text: Natural Soak 1. Cannot wear super-heavy armor.

random.name: Hyper-Dextrous
random.text: When disarmed with a foot free, attempt a Tier 2 Dexterity roll to catch the item with your foot.

random.name: Living in a Volcano
random.text: Immune to heat and fire damage and to being set on fire. Double penalties from cold weather and double damage/effects from cold weapons (e.g. Cryothermal).

random.name: Monkeys are Bastards
random.text: +2 Evade against melee attacks and grabs.

random.name: Numerous Spots
random.text: +4 to all Defense rolls.

random.name: One with the Volcano
random.text: In extreme heat (deserts, volcanos) you can still add bonuses to natural 1s.

random.name: Shaman-in-Training
random.text: Begin with 2 points in Shamanism. Other points may still be added.

random.name: Strong Tail
random.text: Balance on your tail to free all four hands for combat. You cannot move while doing so.

fixed.name: Bio-Flux Immunity
fixed.text: Inorganic immunity: your essence cannot be altered. Unaffected by essence manipulation, bio-zappers, bio-invigoration and other bio-flux effects that change organic structures.

fixed.name: Deficiency Immunity
fixed.text: Inorganic immunity: unaffected by medicines, poisons, gases, diseases and venoms.

fixed.name: Sinks
fixed.text: You cannot swim and sink whenever you are in water.

fixed.name: Augmentable Body
fixed.text: Any body part can take prosthetic augments: each part has 3 empty slots. A DIY-made augment that is not maintained stops working at your next downtime. Extra prosthetic limbs need no Nerve Crafting (no wound loss).

fixed.name: Metal Body
fixed.text: Take damage from electric and similar attacks as if wearing metal armor, whatever armor you wear.

fixed.name: Effectively an Automaton
fixed.text: Anything that affects automatons in a specific way affects you that way too.

fixed.name: Gnome-Sized (optional)
fixed.text: Only if made by a gnome and gnome-sized (narrator): Small Stature (+1 Evade), Light Build (−2 Brute rolls), land speed 15, Smaller Weapons (unarmed DC 1; can't conceal light weapons).

random.name: Armed for Battle
random.text: 1 AP: a limb/body part converts into a standard weapon (melee or firearm) you could have at level 1 for free. It can take augments and cannot be disarmed unless amputated.

random.name: Bio-Mechanical Components
random.text: 1 essence slot that can be augmented. You can now be affected by bio-zappers, bio-invigoration and other bio-flux.

random.name: Buoyant
random.text: You no longer sink. Swim 20 ft. You must hold your breath like organic beings.

random.name: Easy Maintenance
random.text: Restore one of your own wounds during any breather (normally only during downtime). Does not affect wound effects.

random.name: Electrical Shielding
random.text: Take electrical damage like a normal human (Metal Body no longer applies, but metal armor still does).

random.name: Engine Starter
random.text: Choose one power source (combustion, cold, electrical …). 1 AP: restart an engine of that type by touch.

random.name: Exoskeleton
random.text: +4 Defense.

random.name: Heat Generator
random.text: Travel companions are immune to long cold exposure. 1 AP touch: remove negative cold effects (stuns, frostbite) from an organic creature (not the damage).

random.name: Humanlike
random.text: Can pass as human (one coverable giveaway). Observers must first be suspicious, then roll a Tier 2 Cunning to notice.

random.name: Illuminating Sensors
random.text: Shine light 25 ft forward, freely on/off.

random.name: Logical Being
random.text: Use Sciences in place of any Spirit resist.

random.name: Mechanical Knowledge
random.text: Know 2 augments from any crafting skill you take at level 1. With no crafting skill: know 2 prosthetic augments at marque I instead. You start with them built into you, at your discretion.
